statement: Find all quadruplets $(x,y,z,w)$ of positive real numbers satisfying: $x+y+z+w=4$ and $\dfrac{xyz+1}{x+1}=\dfrac{yzw+1}{y+1}=\dfrac{zwx+1}{z+1}=\dfrac{wxy+1}{w+1}$.
Find all positive integers $N$ that are perfect squares and whose decimal representation consists of $n$ digits equal to 2 and one digit equal to 5, where $n$ takes positive integer values.

A triangle $ABC$ with $AB>AC$ is given. $AD$ is the $A$-angle bisector with $D$ on $BC$ and $I$ is the incenter. $M$ is the midpoint of $AD$ and $F$ is the second intersection of $MB$ with the circumcircle of triangle $BIC$. Prove that $AF\perp FC$.

A class consists of 26 students with two students sitting on each desk. Students change seats such that every two students previously sitting together are now apart. Find the maximum value of positive integer $N$ such that, regardless of the students' sitting positions, there is always a set $S$ of $N$ students such that no two of them have ever sat together.
